```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
skill <- readLines("../inst/skills/paparazzi/SKILL.md")
frontmatter_end <- which(skill == "---")[2]
skill <- skill[-seq_len(frontmatter_end)]
skill <- gsub(
  "references/([a-z-]+)\\.md",
  "agent-\\1.html",
  skill
)
cat(skill, sep = "\n")
```
